## Checklist
- [ ] Branch is not `main`; commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally (`check` + `test` + `smoke`)
- [ ] New or changed physics has a test in `test/` and, if user-facing, a row in the README validation table
- [ ] Theory text states assumptions and cites a primary reference
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` items ticked or added; README updated if affected
- [ ] Screenshots regenerated (`npm run screenshots -- <page>`) if visuals changed
